title: Zoe podcast band
description: A full-bleed sunflower-yellow band with soft, paler organic blobs: a semibold eyebrow, a light bookish serif headline and a translucent pill tray of listening-app icons on the left, and a tall 32px-rounded composite image on the right. On phones the image comes first and the text centres beneath it.
notes: the band is the primary colour with primary-foreground text; the blobs use the glow colour
the serif headline uses the theme-only --zoe-serif face, falling back to the display face
